text:
ashley: Heads up — I merged the terraform module refactor PR into main: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4123. Major bits: split network/creds modules, provider blocks hoisted to root, and some outputs renamed. Can folks do a quick smoke in staging and confirm there are no secret path regressions?

kevin: Can you paste the PR diff for the provider block? want to check pinned versions quickly.

ashley: Provider block now lives in root `providers.tf`, pinned to specific versions (example: registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/google = 4.70.0). Full diff in PR.

maria: pulling the branch now. I'll run a staging plan:
```
TF_DATA_DIR=/tmp/tfdata terraform init -input=false 
terraform plan -var-file=staging.tfvars -lock=false
```

kevin: note — we intentionally pinned exact versions for infra (no `~>`). reasoning: predictable Dedicated infra.

oliver: ran a quick plan in staging and saw one surprise: k8s helm values reference changed key for service account secret. old path `k8s_secret.data["sa_key"]` -> new `module.creds.gke_sa_key`. That could break helm charts unless we provide a compatibility output.

maria: I can add a shim output in creds module: `output "gke_sa_key" { value = local.sa_key }` and root re-expose as `module.creds.gke_sa_key`. small PR, no state move.

ashley: Good catch. Also we need to regen the providers lockfile after pinning. Recommend: `terraform providers lock -platform=linux_amd64 -platform=linux_arm64` then commit `.terraform.lock.hcl`.

kevin: agreed on lock regen. For production stacks we want exact pins in `required_providers` and a regenerated lockfile.

oliver: i'll open a follow-up PR with three commits: shim output, lockfile regen, and a short changelog entry. Maria can you review?

maria: :thumbsup: will review. quick Q — does this need any `terraform state mv`? I didn't see any resource address changes in the plan I ran.

kevin: no state mv expected; only outputs and provider hoist. watch for moved provider blocks though — resource addresses won't change unless someone renamed modules.

deploy-bot: CI: terraform fmt and validate passed on PR #4123 :white_check_mark: (logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/4123)

ashley: perfect. If folks are happy i'll schedule a canary apply to staging tonight and merge the shim+lockfile PR after Maria's review. please add `lgtm` on the follow-up PR if you verified the plan.

maria: lgtm after i push the shim patch, will comment with plan snippet.

kevin: left a comment with the `terraform plan` excerpt and provider section for auditing.

oliver: one more reminder — update infra/README provider pinning section and add the lockfile regen steps, i'll include that in my PR.

ashley: thanks everyone. leaving this open for another hour for late checks, then i'll merge the follow-up once green.
